contributor to MP (1872)

CMY’s bank account records the payment of £5 to Miss E.

Gee on 10 April 1873, the only one to a person of this name. A story ‘What the Church Eagle Said’ appeared in MP (December 1872) 4.

Evelyn Gee (b.

Herts. 1843/4), daughter of the Rev.

Richard Gee, Vicar of Abbots Langley and later of Windsor, who married (1880) Richard Rivington Holmes, librarian at Windsor Castle, seems a plausible candidate.

He has an entry in ODNB, which states that she survived him.
